ཞི་ཁྲོ: the peaceful and the wrathful (zhi 'calm' + khro 'fierce'): the hundred deities who appear after death
ཞི་ཁྲོའི: of the peaceful and wrathful ones (zhi khro + -'i 'of')
དགོངས་པ: mind, intention, what an enlightened one has in mind (the respectful word for 'thought')
རང་གྲོལ: freed of itself, natural liberation (rang 'self' + grol 'be freed')
ཆོས་ཉིད: reality itself, the true nature of things (chos 'thing' + nyid 'itself'; Sanskrit dharmatā)
བར་དོ: the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
གསལ་འདེབས: a making clear, a reminder (gsal 'clear' + 'debs 'to cast, to set')
ཐོས་གྲོལ: liberation through hearing (thos 'hear' + grol 'be freed'); the Tibetan name of this book
ཆེན་མོ: great (chen 'big', with the feminine ending often used in titles)
ཞེས: so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
བྱ་བ: called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
བཞུགས་སོ: is present, is here (bzhugs, respectful for 'to sit, to stay', + the sentence-ending -so)
ཆོས་སྐུ: the body of truth, a buddha as reality itself, without form (chos + sku 'body'; Sanskrit dharmakāya)
སྣང་བ་མཐའ་ཡས: Boundless Appearance, Boundless Light: the buddha Amitābha (snang ba 'appearance, light' + mtha' yas 'without limit')
འོད་དཔག་མེད: Measureless Light: the usual Tibetan name of Amitābha ('od 'light' + dpag med 'beyond measure')
ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་སྐུ: the body of perfect enjoyment, a buddha's radiant visionary form (longs spyod 'enjoyment' + rdzogs 'complete' + sku 'body'; Sanskrit saṃbhogakāya)
པདྨ: lotus (Sanskrit padma, written with stacked letters; said 'pema'). Here the Lotus family, the deities grouped around Amitābha
པདྨ་འབྱུང་གནས: Lotus-Born: Padmasambhava, the eighth-century master to whom the book is credited (padma + 'byung gnas 'source, place of arising')
སྤྲུལ་སྐུ: the body of emanation, a buddha appearing in flesh and blood (sprul 'emanate' + sku; Sanskrit nirmāṇakāya; the word 'tulku')
འགྲོ་བའི: of beings ('gro ba 'one who goes', a living being, + -'i 'of') · of going ('gro ba 'to go' + -'i): ngan song du 'gro ba'i 'of going to the lower realms'
སྐུ་གསུམ: the three bodies of a buddha (sku 'body' + gsum 'three')
རྣམས: plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
ལ: to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and'
ཕྱག་འཚལ་ལོ: I bow, homage (phyag 'tshal 'to bow down, to salute' + the sentence-ending -lo)
རྣལ་འབྱོར: yoga; here a yogin, a practitioner (rnal 'the natural state' + 'byor 'to join')
གྲོལ: to be freed, to come free
གྲོལ་བ: being freed, liberation (grol + ba, which makes a verb into a noun)
གྲོལ་བར: to be freed, that one will be freed (grol ba + -r)
དོན: meaning, point, matter; a heading or part of a text
སྟེ: and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
དངོས་གཞི: the main part, the body of a practice or text (dngos 'actual' + gzhi 'basis')
ལུས་ཅན: one who has a body, a living being (lus 'body' + can 'having')
ནི: as for: marks the topic of the sentence
ཁྲིད: guidance, a lama's step-by-step instruction in practice
ཀྱི: of (the form used after d, b, s; also gyi, gi, -'i, yi)
གྱི: of (the form used after n, m, r, l)
གི: of (the form used after g, ng); in this print also written where gis 'by' is meant
ཀྱིས: by, by means of (the 'of' particle + -s; the form used after d, b, s)
གིས: by (the form used after g, ng)
གྱིས: do! (imperative of byed 'to do'); spelled the same as gyis 'by' · by (the 'by' ending as a free word after n, m, r, l): las bzang ngan gyis 'by good or bad karma'
ཉམས་སུ་བླངས: took into experience, put into practice (nyams 'experience' + su 'into' + blangs, past of len 'take'); here as an instruction
དབང་པོ: faculty, capacity; a person's natural ability
དེས་ན: so, therefore, in that case (des 'by that' + na 'if, when')
ན: if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at'
འཆི་ཁའི: of the point of death ('chi kha 'the brink of death' + -'i 'of')
འཆི་ལྟས: signs of death, omens of dying ('chi + ltas 'omen, sign')
འཕོ་བ: transference: sending the consciousness out of the body at death ('pho 'to move across' + ba)
བྱའོ: is to be done, one should (bya, future of byed 'do', + the sentence-ending -'o)
དེ: that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
བརྟག་པ: examination, testing (brtag, future of rtog 'examine', + pa)
གསལ་བའི: making clear, of clarity (gsal ba 'clear, to be clear' + -'i 'of')
གསལ་བར: clearly (gsal ba + -r, which makes an adverb)
ཚང་བའི: of being complete, all present (tshang ba + -'i 'of')
བཏབ་པས: by having given, because it is given (btab pa + -s 'by')
ཐེབས: to take hold, to strike home, to succeed (the result of 'debs)
ཐེབ: to take hold, to succeed (thebs, written here without its final s)
གལ་ཏེ: if (opens a condition that na closes)
ཚེ་འདས: one whose life has passed, the dead person (tshe 'life' + 'das 'gone beyond')
འདུག་སར: on the seat, in the sitting place ('dug sa 'place where one sits' + -r)
བརྗོད: to say, to utter, to declare
ནས: from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
ཉན་པར: listening, as a listener (nyan pa 'to listen' + -r)
དམིགས: to picture in the mind, to focus on
དམིགས་པའི: of picturing, for the imagination (dmigs pa + -'i 'of')
ཤིང: and, while (links two verbs; also cing, zhing)
ཚོས: plural marker of everyday speech, with -s 'by' (tsho + -s)
ངུ་སྐད: the sound of weeping (ngu 'weep' + skad 'voice, sound')
ཡེ་ནས: at all, ever (with a negative: 'not at all')
འདོན: to recite, to utter, to say aloud
རུང་བས: because it is fitting (rung ba 'to be right, allowed' + -s; with mi: 'because it must not')
བསྒྲགས་པའོ: is proclaimed (bsgrags pa, past of sgrog 'announce', + the sentence-ending -'o)
ཕྱི་དབུགས: the outer breath, breathing that can be seen (phyi 'outside' + dbugs 'breath')
ནང་དབུགས: the inner breath, said to go on after breathing stops (nang 'inside' + dbugs 'breath')
ཆད: to stop, to be cut off
ཆད་པའི: of having stopped (chad pa + -'i 'of') · of stopping: chad pa'i grabs 'about to stop'
མཚམས་སུ: at the boundary, at the point (mtshams 'border, juncture' + su 'at')
མཆེད་གྲོགས: a companion in the teaching, fellow disciple (mched 'brother, sister' + grogs 'friend')
གྲོགས་མཆེད: friend and companion (the same two words the other way round)
ཐོབ་པ: one who has gained (thob 'to get, to attain' + pa)
ལ་སོགས་པས: by ... and so on, and the like (la sogs pa 'et cetera' + -s 'by')
རྣ་བར: to the ear, in the ear (rna ba 'ear' + -r)
ཙམ་དུ: just so far, just to the point of (tsam + du)
གཏད: aimed, directed, placed toward (past of gtod)
དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ: the Three Jewels: the Buddha, the teaching and the community (dkon 'rare' + mchog 'supreme' + gsum 'three')
འབུལ: to offer, to give to a superior
འབྱོར: to be at hand, to be within one's means
རྟེན: support, basis; an object that stands for something
སྤྲུལ: to create by the power of the mind, to emanate
བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ: bodhisattva (byang chub 'awakening' + sems dpa' 'hero of mind')
ར་མདའ: help, rescue (ra mda' sbran: 'to call for help')
ལན: time, occasion (lan gsum: three times); also 'answer'
དུ: to, in, as (also tu, su, ru, -r)
འཇིགས་སྐྱོབ་མའི: of 'the one that protects from fear' ('jigs 'fear' + skyob 'protect' + ma, an ending that makes a title, + -'i 'of')
འཕྲང་སྒྲོལ: deliverance from the narrow passage ('phrang 'a dangerous path along a cliff' + sgrol 'to carry across, to free')
རྩ་ཚིག: root verses, the basic text (rtsa 'root' + tshig 'word')
བཅས་ཏེ: together with (bcas + te; dang bcas te: 'along with')
སྦྱར: fitted, joined, applied (past of sbyor; dang sbyar: 'fitted to')
འོད་གསལ: clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
ངོ་སྤྲོད: to point out, to introduce: to bring someone face to face with a thing so that he recognises it (ngo 'face' + sprod 'bring together')
ངོ་སྤྲོད་པ: pointing out, the introduction (ngo sprod + pa)
ངོ་སྤྲད་པ: pointed out, the pointing out (ngo sprad, past of ngo sprod, + pa)
ངོ་སྤྲད་པའི: that was pointed out (ngo sprad pa + -'i 'of')
ངོ་སྤྲད་དོ: points out, will point out (ngo sprad + the sentence-ending -do)
གདབ་བོ: is to be given (gdab + the sentence-ending -bo)
གདབ་ལུགས: the way of giving it (gdab + lugs 'way, manner')
སྲིད་པ: becoming, existence: the round of birth and death
མངལ་སྒོ: the door of the womb (mngal 'womb' + sgo 'door'): the way into a new birth
དགག་ཐབས: means of blocking (dgag 'to stop, to block' + thabs 'means')
བསྟན་པ: teaching, showing (bstan, past of ston 'show', + pa)
ཡང: also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s)
ཀྱང: also, even, though (the form of yang after g, d, b, s)
ངོ: face; the nature or identity of a thing
འཕྲོད: to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
འཕྲོད་བ: meeting, recognising ('phrod + pa, written ba in this print)
གོམ་འདྲིས: familiarity through practice (goms 'to get used to' + 'dris 'well acquainted')
སོ་སོ་སྐྱེ་བོ: an ordinary person, one who is not yet on the path (so so 'each separately' + skye bo 'born one'; Sanskrit pṛthagjana)
ཉམས་ཁྲིད: practical guidance, instruction drawn from experience (nyams 'experience' + khrid 'guidance')
གཞིའི: of the ground (gzhi 'ground, basis': the mind as it is underneath, + -'i 'of')
ཟང་ཐལ: passing straight through, unobstructed (yar gyi zang thal: 'the straight way up')
སྐྱེ་བ་མེད་པ: unborn, without birth (skye ba 'birth' + med pa 'without')
ཞུས་བའི: requested, received as a teaching (zhus pa, humble past of zhu 'ask', written ba in this print, + -'i 'of')
རྩ་བའི: root, principal (rtsa ba 'root' + -'i 'of'; rtsa ba'i bla ma: one's root lama)
འཛོམས: to be present, to come together
གཅིག་པའམ: the same, or (gcig pa 'one and the same' + -'am 'or')
བཤེས་གཉེན་པའམ: a spiritual friend, a teacher, or (bshes gnyen 'friend and kinsman', Sanskrit kalyāṇamitra, + pa + -'am 'or')
ཚར: time, turn (tshar mang du: many times)
དེ་མ་ཐག་ཏུ: at once, immediately (literally 'with no gap from that')
རླུང: wind; the breath-energy that moves in the body's channels (Sanskrit prāṇa)
ཡེ་ཤེས: wisdom, primordial knowing (ye 'from the first' + shes 'know'; Sanskrit jñāna)
དྷཱུ་ཏཱིར: into the central channel (dhūtī, short for Sanskrit avadhūtī, + -r 'into')
སྤྲོས་བྲལ: free of elaboration, beyond concepts (spros 'spreading out, elaboration' + bral 'parted from')
འཆར: to dawn, to arise, to appear
བྲོས་པས: because it has fled (bros pa, past of 'bros 'run away', + -s)
སྣང་བ: appearance, what appears to the senses or the mind; light
ཤོར་བའི: of having escaped, slipped away (shor ba + -'i 'of')
གནས: to remain, to stay; a place
ཁད་པའི: of being close to, on the point of (khad pa + -'i 'of')
མ་ཁད་དུ: as soon as, the moment that
འདི་སྐད་དོ: these words (are said) ('di 'this' + skad 'speech' + the sentence-ending -do)
ཀྱཻ: O! a call for attention (also written kye)
རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
ཆེ་གེ་མོ: so-and-so: here the reader says the person's name
བཙལ་བའི: of seeking (btsal ba, past of 'tshol 'look for', + -'i 'of')
བབ་པར: to have come, to have arrived (bab pa, past of 'bab 'fall, come down', + -r; dus la bab: 'the time has come')
འདུག་པས: since it is, since it appears ('dug pa 'there is, it seems' + -s)
རྗེན་རྗེན་པ: utterly bare (rjen pa with its first syllable doubled for force)
རིག་པ: knowing, awareness itself, before any thought
ཕྱིར: outside, outward(?). The reading is uncertain; another print has dri med, 'stainless', here · here plainly 'out, outward' (phyi 'outside' + -r): phyir log 'turn back out', phyir thon 'come out'
རང་ངོ: one's own face, its own nature (rang 'self' + ngo 'face')
ངང: state, condition; the natural state of something
ཞོག་ཅིག: leave it! rest! (zhog, imperative of 'jog 'to put, to leave', + cig, which marks a command)
འཇགས་སུ: settled, fixed ('jags 'to settle, to stay put' + su)
བཅུག་གོ: causes, makes it be so (bcug, past of 'jug 'put in, cause', + the sentence-ending -go)
གྲབས: preparation, readiness; chad pa'i grabs 'about to stop' (grabs)
འདུག: to sit, to stay; in speech 'is, there is', like yod; after a verb also 'seems' ('dug)
ཕབ: laid down, set down (phab, past of 'bebs 'to lay down')
སེངྒེའི: of the lion (seng ge 'lion' + -'i 'of'; printed with the n and g stacked)
འདུག་སྟངས: posture, manner of sitting ('dug 'sit, stay' + stangs 'manner'): seng ge'i 'dug stangs, the lion's posture
བྱས: did, made, having done (byas, past of byed 'do')
རྦ་རླབས: waves, surging; of the channels, their throbbing (rba 'wave' + rlabs 'wave')
རྩིར་བ: as printed rtsir ba, not a known verb; read, as a guess, as btsir ba 'to press, to squeeze' (btsir + -ba)
ཏེ: and, and so: links a verb to what follows (te, the form of ste after n, r, l; this print also writes it after other letters)
གཉིད་ལོག: sleep, falling asleep (gnyid 'sleep' + log, as in gnyid log 'to fall asleep'): the name of a pair of channels pressed at death
འཕར་འཕྲོ: throbbing still going on ('phar 'to throb, to leap' + 'phro 'what is still going on'); 'phar 'phro chad, 'the last of the throbbing has stopped': a sense built from the parts, a guess
དྲག་ཏུ: firmly, hard (drag 'strong' + tu, making an adverb)
མནན་ནོ: pressed (mnan, past of gnon 'to press' + the sentence-ending -no); here an instruction: press!
དྷུ་ཏི: the central channel, dhūtī (Sanskrit, here printed without its length marks; short for avadhūtī)
ཚངས་བུག: Brahma aperture, the opening at the crown of the head (tshangs 'Brahmā' + bug 'hole')
ལམ་དུ: by way of, along the path (lam 'path' + du 'to, into')
ངེས་སོ: is certain, is sure to (nges 'certain' + the sentence-ending -so)
བྱ: is to be done; called (bya, future of byed 'do'): zhes bya 'is called'
ཆོས་སྐུའི: of the body of truth (chos sku + -'i 'of'; chos 'truth, dharma' + sku 'body')
ཕྱིན་ཅི: in phyin ci log, 'upside down, distorted'; phyin ci ma log pa, 'undistorted'
འགྲོ་བ: going; a being, a living creature ('gro 'go' + -ba: 'one who goes')
རྒྱུད: stream, continuum; a person's mind-stream running on from moment to moment; also 'tantra' (as in mdo rgyud)
ཨཱ་ཝ་དྷཱུ་ཏིར: into the avadhūtī, the central channel (Sanskrit avadhūtī, printed ā va dhū ti, + -r 'into')
ཐིམ་པའི: of dissolving (thim pa 'to dissolve, to sink into' + -'i 'of')
བཟང་ངན: good and bad (bzang 'good' + ngan 'bad'): how good, the degree of soundness
རྩ་རླུང: channels and winds (rtsa 'channel' + rlung 'wind'); also the name of the yoga that works with them
དུམ་པ: a piece, a portion (dum pa 'piece'); dum pa re 'some amount'
རེ: each, one each, some (re); after a noun or number it marks a single one or a certain amount
ཡོད་པ: having, there being; one who has (yod 'there is' + -pa)
ཞི་གནས: calm abiding, meditation that steadies the mind (zhi 'calm' + gnas 'stay'; Sanskrit śamatha)
ཡུན་རིང: long time, a long duration (yun 'duration' + ring 'long')
བསྐྱེད: produced, generated; to produce (bskyed, past and future of skyed 'to produce', the causative of skye 'be born')
དབང་པོའི: of the sense organs (dbang po 'sense faculty' + -'i 'of')
བུ་གར: at, into the opening (bu ga 'hole, opening' + -r 'at, into')
བར་དུ: until, up to (bar 'interval' + -du 'to'); after ma + verb + gyi: 'until it comes'
སྐྱར: to repeat, to do again (skyar, the print's spelling of bskyar)
གསལ་གདབ་བོ: is to be given as a clear reminder (gsal gdab 'cast clearly' + the sentence-ending -bo)
ཡུད་པ: a moment, an instant (yud, as in yud tsam 'a moment', + -pa)
སེ་གོལ: finger-snap (se gol, a snap of the fingers)
རེའི: of one each, of a single (re 'each, one' + -'i 'of')
འོང: comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
མདོ་རྒྱུད: sūtras and tantras (mdo 'sūtra' + rgyud 'tantra'): the Buddha's word
ཕལ་ཆེར: most, mostly (phal cher 'for the most part')
བཞིར: for four, to four (bzhi 'four' + -r 'to, for'); zhag phyed dang bzhi: three and a half days (counting up to the half-finished unit)
ཐུབ: able (thub, to be able, to be capable of)
བཏང: sent, let go (btang, past of gtong 'to send')
འདྲེས་པ: mingled, mixed; close ('dres 'to mix, to mingle' + -pa)
གདའོ: is here, is present (gda', polite spoken 'is' + the sentence-ending -'o)
རིམ་བ: order, succession, stage (rim ba, the print's spelling of rim pa): rim ba ltar 'in order'
གསལ་བཏབ: made clear, reminded (gsal 'clear' + btab, past of 'debs 'to cast'; the past of gsal 'debs)
བཞིན: in the manner of, like, according to (bzhin 'like'); also 'to be like'
སེམས་བསྐྱེད: awakening mind, the resolve to reach awakening for the sake of beings (sems 'mind' + bskyed 'generate')
འདི་ལྟར: in this way, like this ('di 'this' + ltar 'like')
ཕོག་པར: to strike, to reach the mark (phog 'to strike, to hit' + -par): phog par bya 'make it land'
དྲུང་པ: honoured one, one in whose presence one stands (drung 'presence, front' + -pa): respectful address to a lama
ལགས: polite particle after a name or title, 'sir' (lags)
ཐུགས་བསྐྱེད: resolve, the awakening mind (thugs 'heart-mind', respectful + bskyed 'generate'; respectful form of sems bskyed)
ཡེངས་པར: distractedly, in distraction (yengs pa 'to be distracted' + -r): ma yengs par 'undistracted'
མཛོད: please do, please make (mdzod, respectful imperative of byed 'do')
འཚལ: I ask, I beg ('tshal, humble 'ask for, wish')
སྐད་ཆུང: low voice (skad 'voice' + chung 'small'). The print has skad chung dus, 'voice-low time'; read, as a guess, as skad chung du, 'in a low voice'
ཞུས: said, spoke, requested (zhus, past of zhu, humble verb for speaking to a superior)
མཛོད་ཅིག: please do! (mdzod, respectful 'do!' + cig, which marks a command)
ཀྱེ་མ: alas! a cry of sorrow (kye ma)
བབ: came down, has arrived (bab, for babs, past of 'bab 'to come down'): bab nas 'dug 'has arrived'
བསྒོམ་པ: meditating, meditation (bsgom, future of sgom 'to meditate', + -pa)
མཉམ་པའི: of those equal, equal to (mnyam pa 'equal' + -'i 'of')
དོན་དུ: for the sake of (don 'meaning, benefit' + -du 'to, for')
ཐོབ་བར: to attain, to obtain (thob 'obtain' + -bar, 'to, will'); the print's spelling of thob par
སྙམ་དུ: thinking, 'so I think' (snyam 'think' + -du): closes the words of a resolve, as zhes closes speech
ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྐུར: as the body of truth (chos kyi sku 'body of truth' + -r 'as')
ཤེས་བར: to know, to recognise (shes 'know' + -bar, to); the print's spelling of shes par
ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོ: Great Seal, mahāmudrā: the realisation of the mind's nature (phyag rgya 'seal' + chen po 'great')
ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོའི: of the Great Seal (phyag rgya chen po + -'i 'of')
མངོན་དུ: manifest, openly, before the eyes (mngon 'clear, manifest' + -du 'to, as'); mngon du byas 'made manifest'
སྣང་བས: by the appearance, by the appearing (snang ba 'appearance' + -s 'by')
ནམ་མཁའི: of the sky, of space (nam mkha' + -'i 'of')
བྲལ་བར: parted, separated (bral 'be parted' + -bar, 'to'); ma bral bar 'without parting from'
ཁྱེད་རང: you yourself, the more polite 'you' (khyed 'you' + rang 'self')
གོམས་པའི: of the familiarised, of what is trained in (goms pa 'be familiar' + -'i 'of')
གདམས་ངག: instruction, a lama's oral advice (gdams 'instruct' + ngag 'speech')
ཅེས: so, thus: closes speech (ces, the form of zhes after g, d, b)
འཇུག་པར: letting enter, causing to enter ('jug 'enter' + -par); yengs su mi 'jug par 'not letting go into distraction'
གསལ་གདབ: to make clear, to remind (gsal 'clear' + gdab, future of 'debs 'to cast'; the verb of gsal 'debs)
ཚར་བ: finished, completely done (tshar 'be finished' + -ba); after a verb 'completely'
བཤེས་གཉེན་བ: spiritual friend, teacher (bshes gnyen 'friend' + -ba; the print's spelling of bshes gnyen pa)
གྱིས་ཤིག: do! (gyis, imperative of byed 'do', + shig, which marks a command)
འཇོག་པར: to rest, to place ('jog 'place, rest' + -par, 'to'); thog tu 'jog par zhu 'I beg you to rest upon'
ཞུའོ: is to be requested, request (zhu + the sentence-ending -'o)
ཉོན་ཅིག: listen! (nyon, imperative of nyan 'listen', + cig, which marks a command)
ཨང: ang: the letters are clear, the sense is not; taken, as a guess, for a spoken cry that presses a command home
ད་ལྟའི: of the present, of now (da lta 'now' + -'i 'of')
ཤེས་རིག: knowing-awareness, present awareness (shes 'know' + rig 'awareness'; shes pa and rig pa together)
ངོ་བོ: essence, nature, what a thing is in itself (ngo bo)
སིང་ངེ་བ: vivid, bright (sing nge ba, a descriptive word with a doubled sound)
ངོ་བོར: as an essence, as a nature (ngo bo + -r 'as')
གྲུབ་པ: established, proved to exist (grub 'be established' + -pa); ma grub pa 'not established as anything'
སང་ངེ་བར: open and clear, wide open (sang nge ba + -r, making an adverb)
འདི་ཀ: this very, this same ('di 'this' + ka, intensifier)
ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་མོ: the All-Good Lady, Samantabhadrī, the female buddha who stands for reality as empty (kun tu 'in every way' + bzang 'good' + -mo, feminine)
ཕྱལ་ཆད་དུ: into a blank, a mere void (phyal chad, a rare word whose sense is a guess from context, + du 'into')
སོང་བར: gone (song, past of 'gro 'to go', + -bar): ma song bar 'not having gone'
སིང་ང: vivid (sing nga as printed; the last syllable is uncertain, perhaps sing nge, as in sing nge ba)
ཝལ་ལེ་བ: distinct, sharp, crisp (wal le ba, a descriptive word)
ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་པོ: the All-Good, Samantabhadra, the male buddha who stands for clear awareness (kun tu 'in every way' + bzang 'good' + -po, masculine)
ཕྱེད་པར: divided, split (phyed, a form of 'byed 'divide' + -par, 'to'); dbyer mi phyed 'not divisible'
ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྐུ: body of truth, the buddha as reality itself, without form (chos kyi sku)
ཆེན་པོར: as a great one, great (chen po 'great' + -r 'as')
འོད་མི་འགྱུར་བ: the buddha Unchanging Light, Light That Does Not Change ('od 'light' + mi 'gyur ba 'unchanging')
ཤེས: to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
ཆོག་གོ: it suffices, it will do (chog 'enough' + the sentence-ending -go)
ཤེས་རིགས: knowing-awareness: shes rig as printed once with a final s (shes rigs), which the following kyi agrees with; the print elsewhere writes shes rig, and it is read so
སང་ངེ་བ: open and clear, vivid (sang nge ba)
སངས་རྒྱས་སུ: as buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas + -su 'as')
རིགས་པ: knowing, awareness: rig pa as printed once with a final s (rigs pa); the print elsewhere writes rig pa, and it is read so (rigs pa as a word is 'reasoning, what is fitting', which gives no sense here)
བརྗོད་དོ: says, is to be said (brjod, past and future of rjod 'to say', + the sentence-ending -do)
རང་རིག: self-knowing, awareness aware of itself (rang 'self' + rig 'know')
འོད་གསལ་དུ: as clear light, into clear light ('od gsal + -du 'as, into')
འདུ་འབྲལ: meeting and parting ('du 'meet, gather' + 'bral 'part'); 'du 'bral med pa 'without meeting or parting'
གྱུར: become, turned into ('gyur; past form gyur)
ཟིན: seized, caught; held (zin, the intransitive verb beside 'dzin 'to hold'): ngos zin 'recognise'
དོགས: fear, suspicion (dogs 'to fear, to suspect'); dogs na 'if it is feared that'
ཅིག: one, a (gcig written without its prefix g-)
ཡོད་མེད: whether there is or not (yod 'there is' + med 'there is not')
བསྟུན་ནོ: is in keeping with, depends on (bstun 'conform' + the sentence-ending -no)
ཡིན་ནམ: is it? (yin 'be' + nam, 'or' of a question)
དུ་རྒོད: as printed du rgod, which gives no sense; probably ngu rgod 'weeping and laughing' (ngu 'weep' + rgod 'laugh'), a guess
འཁྲུལ་སྣང: deluded appearance, illusory vision ('khrul 'be deluded' + snang 'appear')
གཤིན་རྗེའི: of the Lord of Death, Yama (gshin rje 'lord of the dead' + -'i 'of')
སླེབ་བའི: of having arrived (sleb 'arrive', spoken + -pa'i 'of'; printed sleb ba'i)
གདབ: to be given, to cast (gdab, future of 'debs 'to cast, to give')
རྫོགས་རིམ་པ: practitioner of the completion stage (rdzogs rim 'completion stage' + -pa 'one who')
བསྐྱེད་རིམ་པ: practitioner of the generation stage (bskyed rim 'generation stage' + -pa 'one who')
རྫོགས་རིམ་པར: (as) a practitioner of the completion stage (rdzogs rim pa + -r; the -r is unexpected and its sense uncertain)
གོང: above, before, earlier (gong 'above'); gong gi 'the one above'
ངོ་སྤྲད: pointing out, face-introduction (ngo sprad, past of ngo sprod 'point out')
བསྐྱེད་རིམ: generation stage: visualising oneself as a deity (bskyed 'generate' + rim 'stage')
བསྒོམ་ཁོག: the frame of a meditation, its outline (bsgom, future of sgom 'meditate', + khog 'frame, inside')
མངོན་རྟོགས: clear realisation, the text describing a deity to be visualised (mngon 'clear' + rtogs 'realise')
ཀློགས: read out (klogs, imperative of klog 'to read')
སྒོམས་ཤིག: meditate! (sgoms, imperative of sgom 'meditate', + shig, which marks a command)
ཡེངས་ཤིག: be distracted! (yengs 'to be distracted' + shig, which marks a command): ma yengs shig 'do not be distracted'
གཏོད་ཅིག: direct! turn! (gtod 'to aim, to direct' + cig, which marks a command)
ཆུ་ཟླ: moon in water, reflection of the moon (chu 'water' + zla 'moon')
གདོས་བཅས་ཅན་དུ: as having matter, as something solid (gdos 'matter' + bcas 'having' + can 'possessing' + -du 'as')
ཇོ་བོ: lord, master (jo bo); title of Avalokiteśvara
ཐུགས་རྗེ་ཆེན་པོ: Great Compassion, Avalokiteśvara (thugs rje 'compassion', respectful + chen po 'great')
ངོ་སྤྲད་པས: by being pointed out (ngo sprad 'point out' + -pa + -s 'by')
ཟིན་པ: seizing, holding; recognising (zin 'be seized, be held' + -pa): ngos mi zin pa 'one who does not recognise'
ཟིན་པར: seizing, holding (zin + -par): zin par the tshom med 'no doubt that (they) will seize it'
གསོན་བོའི: of the living (gson po 'living', printed gson bo + -'i 'of')
ཐེབས་པས: because it takes hold (thebs 'strike, take hold' + -pas 'because')
འཆི་ཁར: at the brink of death ('chi kha 'point of death' + -r 'at')
དྲག་པོས: by the fierce, by the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
ཟིན་པའི: of holding, of seizing (zin pa + -'i 'of'): dran pas mi zin pa'i 'whose memory cannot hold'
ཉམས: decline, wane, be damaged (nyams); of a vow, 'broken'
ངན་སོང་དུ: into the lower realms, bad destinies (ngan song 'bad going' + -du 'into')
ཅི་ནས་ཀྱང: by all means, at all costs (ci nas kyang)
